content:
The HWPX renewal update failed because required customer information was missing from the generated XML sections.
The run failed with a verifier reward of 0.00 due to an AssertionError in test_required_updates_present_and_old_values_removed. Specifically, the value 'Asteron Commerce' (update['customer']) was not found in either section0.xml or section1.xml. While the environment setup and subprocess execution of pytest worked, the document automation failed to correctly inject the updated customer, owner, and window values into the HWPML XML structure.
